customManagers.description: Versions pinned as a value rather than as a dependency: a tool version passed to an action, a `go install ...@vX` argument, a `pipx install pkg==X`. No standard manager reads any of these, so without this an unwatched pin goes stale silently while the step it configures still reports green. Each site carries a `renovate:` comment naming its datasource, so the pin says what watches it.
